title: White Ball Cornflower - 2x Plug Plants -  Easy Grow Native Pollinator Friendly
description:
.Cornflower ‘White Ball’ (Centaurea cyanus) – 2 Plug Plants – Bee-Friendly Cottage Garden Annual
 

  Cornflower
 ‘White Ball’ is a compact, double-flowered cornflower with crisp white 
blooms that bring a fresh, elegant look to borders, cutting patches, and
 cottage-style plantings. Highly attractive to bees and other 
pollinators, it flowers freely and pairs beautifully with pastels and 
blues.
 

  Excellent as a cut flower: the sturdy stems and prolific 
blooms last well in a vase and mix seamlessly with other garden flowers.
 

  Key Details:
 

   Variety: Cornflower ‘White Ball’
  

   Quantity: 2 Plug Plants
  

   Type: Annual
  

   Genus: Centaurea cyanus
  

   Flower Colour: Pure white, double blooms
  

   Height & Spread: Approx. 60–80 cm tall × 25–30 cm wide
  

   Flowering Period: June – September
  

  Planting and Care Instructions:
 

   When to Plant Out: July – October, after the risk of frost
  

   Growing Conditions:
   
     Full sun
    

     Prefers poor to moderately fertile, well-drained soil
    

     Benefits from light support or netting in exposed, windy sites
    


   Care Tips:
   
     Water regularly until established, then water as needed in dry spells
    

     Keep cutting and deadheading to encourage continuous flowering
    


  Why Choose ‘White Ball’?
  

  A reliable, easy-to-grow, pollinator-friendly cornflower with neat, 
double white blooms that brighten borders and make superb cut flowers. 
Ideal for cottage gardens, wildlife-friendly schemes, and mixed beds.
